0.original: Auphiliot would be most grateful if you could hunt down some Garlean interlopers in his stead.

1.original: A number of the Garleans responsible for the disappearance of the sylph elder remain in the area. Investigate the specified locations, and vanquish any Garleans you come upon.

2.original: The Garlean intruders are no more. Report your success to Auphiliot.

3.original: Thanks to your efforts, the Garleans have been driven off, and a small measure of peace has returned to the Twelveswood. At least for the moment.

24.original: Investigate the specified locations and defeat Garleans.

48.original: Yer back, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>, an' somethin' tells me ye've not come for a flagon o' Buscarron's ale. All the better, that. I just overheard some Garlean stragglers was seen in the Twelveswood, an' ye know they're not like to be up to any good.

49.original: Me? Why, I'd like nothin' more than to gut those imperial whoresons meself, but I fear I've─<hex:021A020203>hic<hex:021A020103>!─other...duties...to attend this day. We're countin' on ye, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>!

52.original: Saw to those Garlean dogs as swift an' sure as I saw to me pint o'─er, me <hex:021A020203>duties<hex:021A020103>, did ye? On behalf of old man Buscarron an' me compatriots here at the Druthers, ye have─<hex:021A020203>hurk<hex:021A020103>!─me gratitude, an' then some.

53.original: What with ye an' meself seein' to matters, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>, I tell ye: no flagon o' mead or Garlean troublemaker on or around these premises is─<hex:021A020203>hic<hex:021A020103>─safe!
